selection: Every Category H10 onset in all 22 reused Train development sequences; mark the already sealed M74 strict content-harm intervals. No sequence or failure subset is dropped.
comparisons: At the same physical Category-failure time, compare each content condition own prior bbox/search state. These are different complete trajectories, not same-state head probes.
crop: Exact native ceil(sqrt(w*h)*4), round(center-halfside) geometry from prior public xywh.
GT_policy: Posthoc diagnostics only, not a deployable trigger; invalid GT never automatically means absent target.
limitations: Search inclusion does not prove a correct candidate exists.
H10 onset is the first frame of a sustained low-overlap interval, not necessarily the first earlier tracking error.
Reused development events are not an unbiased held-out test.
